snippet.title: Who’s the oldest player in World Cup history? 👴
snippet.description:
Cristiano Ronaldo is 41 years old, but he still doesn’t make the top 3 oldest players in tournament history.

At #5 is Peter Shilton. The England goalkeeper was 40 years and 292 days old at the 1990 World Cup in Italy, helping England reach the semi-finals.

At #4 is Northern Ireland legend Pat Jennings, who played at the 1986 World Cup in Mexico at exactly 41 years old. Ronaldo’s taking his 4th place.

At #3 there’s Cameroon striker Roger Milla, who was 42 years and 39 days old at the 1994 World Cup in the United States.

At #2 is Colombian goalkeeper Faryd Mondragón. He was 43 years and 3 days old when he came on for the final five minutes of Colombia's last group stage match at the 2014 World Cup.

And at #1 is Egypt's Essam El-Hadary, who was 45 years and 161 days old when he started against Saudi Arabia, saved a penalty, and became the oldest player ever to appear at a FIFA World Cup.

#soccer #football #WorldCup #CristianoRonaldo #Portugal

snippet.title: Football Player's Shirt Numbers = Their Ages👨‍🦳⚽️
snippet.description:
What if footballers were actually the same age as their jersey numbers? 😭💀

At first, it sounds like a harmless question…

But then you start looking at the numbers 👀

First up…

👉 DONNARUMMA — Number 99

99 YEARS OLD 😭

At that point, bro doesn’t even get an old-age filter…

He gets a TOMBSTONE 💀😂

Then comes João Neves.

👉 Number 87

Suddenly the young PSG midfielder turns into an 87-year-old man 😭

Grey hair.  
Wrinkles.  
A completely different João Neves.

Next…

👉 PACHO — Number 51

51 years old.

Still defending…

Just with a few more grey hairs now 😂

Then Manchester City enter the challenge.

👉 PHIL FODEN — Number 47

Imagine Foden playing Premier League football at 47 years old 😭

The haircut changed.  
The face aged.  
But somehow he still looks ready to play 😂

And finally…

👉 LEWIS-SKELLY — Number 49

From one of Arsenal’s youngsters…

To a 49-year-old veteran in seconds 💀

Five players.  
Five shirt numbers.  
Five completely different ages.

But Donnarumma definitely got the worst deal 😭⚰️

Imagine if EVERY footballer had to be the same age as their jersey number 😂

#football #soccer #donnarumma #joaoneves #foden #lewisskelly #arsenal #mancity #psg #footballmemes #viralshorts #shorts #footballshorts
